reviews.t: DONT DOUBT IT; BUY IT NOW!
reviews.x: Let me just say WOW. These have exceeded my expectations! I normally don’t wear false lashes because I am no good at putting them on, like it literally takes me an hour to glue one on right and then I fight with the other eye to look decent lol  I was super skeptical about ordering these because of how cheap they were and when the packaging came it was very cheep and flimsy so I was worried; but I’m glad I did buy them!! I had both eyelashes on and ready to go in under five minutes! I only had t

I wore these lashes for about 12 hours straight yesterday, and I can honestly say that I’m very pleased with them. I am not accustomed to lashes this long, so I was worried that they would get in the way and be obnoxious or heavy, but I was pleasantly surprised by how light and comfortable these are. I also really like the use of the eyeliner as adhesive! It took me forever to get used to wearing false lashes with glue, but these lashes went on with no problem the first attempt and stuck all day
These lashes look gorgeous and are easy to apply with the liner. Once you fit them to your eye shape, you just apply the liner and the lashes attach much easier than using glue!

I love these! They are GREAT for the price; only downside is the eyeliner isn’t the best. After a while the lashes will start lifting in my inner or outer corners. They are definitely more comfortable then magnetic lashes; and they are very easy to apply. If I could find a different eyeliner; these would be my go to lashes. Right now I have been using these daily, I just have to reapply the eyeliner mainly in the inner and outer corners  after about 4-5 hours. I have used one pair of lashes 5 or

These are definitely the easiest option for false lashes. Last time I tried the traditional way but had an allergic reaction from the glue. These, however, are great! I would only suggest offering some shorter lengths. I did have to cut mine down until they felt more comfortable on my face. Overall, these were worth the money!

First of all it literally took me less than 5min to put them on I struggle with the glue strip lashes,but these literally the magnets pulled to my eyelids and you actually felt it stick easy to adjust and I wore them for 3days I used 3layers of the eyeliner and still had to pull to take them off I purchased them again to have a backup 💫

These re very easy to apply. These would be more for going out as they just look ridiculous for every day use. they are too full and too long, do not look natural at all. i also needed to cut them a little to fit my eye lid. The eyeliner is very hard to remove.

Ladies if you are in the market for some easy to use , full, and amazing lashes.  These are it!!! I love these.  Easy to put on.  It really as simple as applying the liner and attaching the lashes.  I highly highly recommend these.  You will not be sorry

Pretty disappointed in this product. Lashes are pretty but I had to cut them. They don’t magnetize they’re definitely just glue. No magnets on them at all. Eyeliner goes on easy. Deff not worth buying.

reviews.t: Too many re-application and doesn't stand heat or sweat.
reviews.x: I love putting my beauty products to the test. I was looking for something to add to my hospital bag to add to my "look" once I have my baby- pics and all of that. I found this and purchased based on the reviews. I think all these positive reviews is just to get the next box free since there is a code and all of that and the box literally says that. Yes, application is ridiculously easy BUT I found myself reapplying the liner multiple times in the day after being outdoors etc. The corners of the

reviews.t: Great Lashes, look and feel amazing
reviews.x: I have always wanted lashes. I refuse to pay a ton of money to get them done. With other products I've tried they don't stick, I can look out and see the lashes, they've been heavy etc. Not these. The lashes are extremely light weight. They actually stick very well and you can't see them when you look out. I love these lashes. These are a definitely a buy!

reviews.t: I was scare BUT I FELL IN LOVE!
reviews.x: They just might have done something here! I bragged about this product so much, someone stole it from me while i was helping dress the bride. Its an easy application and a lot cleaner. The lashes are light weight and natural. Definitely will buy again!

reviews.t: Easy to use 2-in-1 eyeliner adhesive, cute fluffy lashes
reviews.x: I have been wanting to try a 2 in 1 adhesive for a while when I came across these. The eyeliner adhesive pen works very well to draw a cat eye. The adhesive quality is pretty good. The lashes stayed on all day and only my right lash lifted in the center a bit, which could be my fault as this was my first time using adhesive like this.  The lashes themselves are super cute! I was worried they might be too long, but they're very fluffy so it's not as dramatic of a look as you think it will be.

Absolutely the best. I have curly lashes and have a hard time with glued lashes. I get so frustrated I just don’t even bother..but these!!! Beautiful, lightweight and 3D. Easiest application ever. Tip; do one eye at a time and wing it out so that the end of the lashes hold tight. The eyeliner dries quickly. The lashes come off easy but hold tight without adjusting. The eyeliner will stay on unless really scrubbing but I’m not too worried about that. Will def keep in rotation.

I have extremely limited vision without my glasses. I'm not allowed to wear contacts. Being able to just put a liner on and then my lashes attach so easily means a lot to me. This product is awesome for me, and a lot of women who wear eyeglasses. It has  given me the look of falsies without all the hassle.  The great thing I love about them is the adhesive doesn't take out my lashes. Great product I just wish the lashes come in different lengths.

reviews.t: It seriously does work. But color transfers
reviews.x: They seriously do work. I was skeptical but it was super easy. I just used my own lashes because the ones that came in the pack were too flashy ( maybe good for a party but not for work). So I'm happy you can use it with any lashes. Will be repurchasing! Edit: the black eyeliner transfers to your upper lids. You have to make a very thin line and make sure the lash completely covers the eyeliner to keep it from transferring to the top lid.

Great lashes! Not only are they great quality but they’re also easy to use. I wore the first pair twice already and they still look brand new. The eye liner pen makes putting them on seamless! I will never go back to wearing lashes with glue. These were easy to put on and the adhesion is great hard. I’d definitely recommend these lashes for beginners too.

reviews.t: Poor quality materials make them uncomfortable to wear.
reviews.x: Easy to use, but they feel like they're made from cheap materials- they're somewhat prickly, itchy and don't feel anything approaching even the approximation of real. I wore them for just two hours one evening and I was already having trouble with them staying in place despite applying according to directions and using three layers of the provided liner.

I’ve ordered many sets of magnetic lashes on Amazon. Most have individual magnets, which don’t last very long in my experience. These lashes are lightweight, comfortable, and the entire lash strip is magnetic. The magnetic liner comes in a felt tip version and is extremely easy to use & not messy. These are by far my favorite lashes so far!!

Horrible, NOT natural at all... If you want to look like a Drag Queen you buy this, if not then this is NOT the right product for you.  Some women like this, I don't. I was looking for something with volume but still natural looking, but this is NOT what I had in mind...Bought the cheapeast ones amazon have an LOVE IT.

These lashes turned out to be really good : light-weighted, soft, adjustable, reusable and last pretty long The kit includes both the eyeliner and the special tool to put the lashes on. The eyeliner doesn't fade away until cleaned off. I would recommend this product even if you have never used faux lashes before

Trust me you need these in your life! I purchased these thinking they were magnetic and then quickly realized they weren’t when trying to apply. To make these work you need to apply the liner generously and while still wet apply the lashes. They stay on my whole 12 hour shift at work and then some.

Honestly this was such a waste of money. The eyelashes don’t stick to the eyeliner. I’m very familiar with applying false lashes and I’ve tried to apply these several different ways and none of them worked. My eyelashes were constantly coming undone. Do not recommend.

I love how quickly the liner dries and the lashes stick! Totally worth the money, you get 3 sets of lashes that are super full and fluffy, jet black eye liner, and the applicator. My first time purchasing and trying the magnetic liner lashes and I love them!

reviews.t: Lashes are good, liner is more like glue
reviews.x: I like these! They're easy to apply and stick really well. My only issue is that the liner is more like glue, and if you use too much or apply it too high on your lid, it can stick to your brow bone and can get a little messy, especially if you sweat.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes.
Many reviewers find the lashes lightweight and comfortable to wear.
Several reviewers praise the lashes for looking beautiful, full, and natural.
Some reviewers report problems with the eyeliner adhesive, including lashes lifting at the corners and the liner being hard to remove.
A few reviewers complain that the lashes are too long or full and needed trimming to fit.
